basic_details.job_title: APCRDA Recruitment 2026 – Apply Online for 4 Senior Specialist/Engineer, Junior Specialist/Engineer and More Posts
basic_details.short_information: The Andhra Pradesh Capital Region Development Authority (APCRDA), Amaravati, is engaging 2 Senior Specialist/Engineer (Sustainability / Environment Management), 1 Junior Specialist/Engineer (Sustainability / Environment Management) and 1 Senior Specialist/Engineer-OHS in its ESM Unit on contract basis for a tenure of one year, at a monthly consolidated pay of Rs.87,480/- to Rs.1,01,970/-. The essential qualification is a Master's degree in the relevant field, with 5 to 10 years of experience depending on the post. Applications are made online at https://crda.ap.gov.in in the careers tab from 2

content_sections.heading: About APCRDA
content_sections.text: The Andhra Pradesh Capital Region Development Authority, Amaravati, has its project office on the 2nd, 3rd and 5th Floors, APCRDA Project Office, Rayapudi Post, Tulluru Mandal, Amaravati, Guntur District, Andhra Pradesh – 522237. The notification is signed by the Commissioner, APCRDA. The posts sit in the ESM Unit, and the notice describes the OHS post as serving the Amaravati Sustainable and Inclusive Green Field City project.

content_sections.heading: Vacancy Details
content_sections.text: The notification invites applications for 4 posts in total. The number of posts is subject to variation based on project requirements.

content_sections.heading: Who Can Apply
content_sections.text: The notice prints qualification and experience for each post as follows. It prints no age limit. For both posts the experience must be relevant experience on sustainable development, energy efficiency, climate change (resilience, adaptation and mitigation measures), alternative energy sources, GHGs accounting etc., carbon financing. The notice also lists the following as part of the requirement: Building level climate friendly interventions/materials, city level climate friendly measures, city level climate action plans development and implementation, CERs transactions etc. Thorough understanding and working knowledge with sustainability software tools (e.g., carbon footprint calculators, energy management software, sustainability reporting tools, EDGE Rating). Deep knowledge of GHG emissions accounting, green building certifications, and energy conservation codes. Strong data analysis, reporting, and presentation skills. Experience in renewable energy systems, energy audits, sustainable and climate resilient urban infrastructure planning. The experience required is occupational health and safety management, preferably in large infrastructure or urban development projects. The notice also lists: Proven experience in developing and implementing OHS policies and programs. Technical expertise: knowledge of national and international OHS standards, including ISO 45001, international best practices, Environmental and Social Standards (ESS) and international best practices Safeguard Policy. Familiarity with risk assessment methodologies and safety audits. Skills: strong leadership and team management skills; ability to train and build capacity on OHS matters; excellent communication and reporting skills; experience working on international best practices-funded projects and complying with associated OHS requirements. Candidates should check the official notification for the discipline-specific eligibility of each post.

content_sections.heading: Pay and Tenure
content_sections.text: The pay is a monthly consolidated amount: Rs.1,01,970/- for the Senior Specialist/Engineer posts (both Sustainability / Environment Management and OHS) and Rs.87,480/- for the Junior Specialist/Engineer post. The engagement is on contract basis for a contract tenure of one year. The notice states the requirement as immediate. The place of work is APCRDA, Rayapudi, Amaravati, Guntur District.

content_sections.heading: APCRDA Recruitment 2026 Job Description
content_sections.text: The notice prints one list of tasks for both of these posts. Planning for Sustainability: accounting of GHG emissions and designing the journey towards carbon neutrality; lead initiatives on energy efficiency, adoption of technology to tap renewable energy, and green interventions/materials in development projects. Green Building Design and Energy Conservation: develop guidelines and frameworks for integrating green building practices and achieving compliance with energy conservation building codes (ECBC); collaborate with architects and developers to ensure projects adhere to sustainable construction principles. Energy Management: implement energy efficiency measures including VFD pumps, renewable energy systems like solar rooftops, district cooling solutions etc.; conduct energy audits to optimize energy consumption across urban infrastructure and development projects. GHG Emissions Monitoring and Reporting: oversee carbon footprint assessments, GHG inventory development, and climate risk analysis; prepare periodic implementation monitoring reports and strategies for further GHGs mitigation. Stakeholder Engagement and Compliance: collaborate with stakeholders (government agencies, developers) to integrate sustainability into urban policies, plans and programmes, and drive sustainable development by ensuring compliance with national energy policies, climate action plans, and green building certifications etc. OHS Strategy Development: develop and implement a comprehensive OHS strategy for the Amaravati Sustainable and Inclusive Green Field City project to ensure the safety of all workers and residents. Risk Assessment: conduct regular risk assessments and safety audits across construction sites and project facilities. Policy Implementation: establish and enforce safety policies and procedures in compliance with national and international best practices standards. Stakeholder Engagement: coordinate with contractors and government bodies to ensure compliance with OHS regulations. Training Programs: design and conduct OHS training sessions for construction workers, supervisors and other stakeholders. Monitoring and Reporting: monitor compliance with safety standards and prepare regular reports on OHS performance. Objective: to ensure the health and safety of all personnel involved in the Amaravati project, minimizing risks and promoting a culture of safety. Scope of Work: develop and oversee the implementation of OHS policies and procedures in line with international standards; conduct safety inspections and ensure compliance with ESS and the Safeguard Policy. The notice lists these deliverables for the OHS post: Comprehensive OHS management plan for the entire Amaravati project. Safety policies and procedures developed in compliance with national and international standards. Regular safety audit reports, including actionable recommendations. faq.question: Q1. How many vacancies are there in APCRDA Recruitment 2026?
faq.answer: There are 4 posts: 2 Senior Specialist/Engineer (Sustainability / Environment Management), 1 Junior Specialist/Engineer (Sustainability / Environment Management) and 1 Senior Specialist/Engineer-OHS. The number of posts is subject to variation based on project requirements.

faq.question: Q2. What is the last date to apply for APCRDA Recruitment 2026?
faq.answer: The last date to apply is 8 December 2026. Online applications open on 24 November 2026.

faq.question: Q3. What is the qualification for the Senior and Junior Specialist/Engineer posts?
faq.answer: A Bachelor's degree in Electrical/Mechanical Engineering with a Master's degree in any relevant Engineering/Sciences, a Bureau of Energy Efficiency (BEE) certified energy auditor, and Green Building Certifications (e.g., EDGE, IGBC, LEED, GRIHA). The Senior post needs a minimum of 8 years of relevant experience and the Junior post 5 years.

faq.question: Q4. What is the qualification for the Senior Specialist/Engineer-OHS post?
faq.answer: A Master's degree in Occupational Health and Safety, Environmental Health, Industrial Safety, or a related field, with a minimum of 10 years of experience in occupational health and safety management, preferably in large infrastructure or urban development projects.

faq.question: Q5. What is the salary in APCRDA Recruitment 2026?
faq.answer: The monthly consolidated pay is Rs.1,01,970/- for the two Senior Specialist/Engineer (Sustainability / Environment Management) posts and the Senior Specialist/Engineer-OHS post, and Rs.87,480/- for the Junior Specialist/Engineer post.

faq.question: Q6. How do I apply for APCRDA Recruitment 2026?
faq.answer: Apply online on the APCRDA website https://crda.ap.gov.in in the careers tab. Applications received through any other source or mode will not be processed.

faq.question: Q7. Is the APCRDA job permanent?
faq.answer: No. The posts are filled on contract basis, and the contract tenure is one year.

faq.question: Q8. Where will the selected candidates work?
faq.answer: The place of work is APCRDA, Rayapudi, Amaravati, Guntur District. The notice states the requirement as immediate.

faq.question: Q9. Can APCRDA cancel the notification or leave posts unfilled?
faq.answer: Yes. APCRDA reserves the right to fill or not fill any or all of the notified posts and to amend, modify, withdraw or cancel the notification, either in whole or in part, without assigning any reason.
